title: 第一卷 第5章 陆老师，偷听？
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾南舟看了一眼旁边的工作人员，压低声音：“我们能单独聊聊吗？”

宋尔尔：“不能。”

顾南舟一愣。

他大概没想到她拒绝得这么快。

“为什么？”

宋尔尔指了指头顶摄像头：“公共区域持续录制。”

顾南舟：“那去没有摄像头的地方。”

宋尔尔：“更不能。”

顾南舟皱眉：“你现在一定要这么防着我？”

宋尔尔：“不是防你，是防舆论。”

她语气挺平静。

“你找我，拍到叫旧情难忘，拍不到叫私下密会。”

“你说你只是想聊聊，网友说我又倒贴你，最后你收获深情人设，我收获一顿骂。”

“顾南舟，这流程我熟。”

顾南舟表情微变。

林栀刚好从客厅另一侧走过，听见这句，脚步顿了一下。

姜眠也没敢动。

周闻野站在楼梯口，抱着胳膊看热闹。

顾南舟沉默几秒，声音低下来：“你以前不是这样的。”

宋尔尔点头：“对，我以前比较傻。”

顾南舟：“我不是这个意思。”

宋尔尔：“没关系，我是这个意思。”

顾南舟被噎住。

宋尔尔看了眼时间：“没别的事我先上去了，我得休息。”

顾南舟下意识问：“你就这么不想跟我说话？”

宋尔尔：“也不是。”

顾南舟眼底刚有点松动。

宋尔尔继续：“主要是没有加班费。”

周闻野直接转身，肩膀抖了一下。

姜眠低头咬住嘴唇。

林栀的表情也没绷住。

顾南舟脸色沉得厉害。

宋尔尔没再管他，拖着拖鞋上楼。

刚走到楼梯拐角，就看见陆执站在那里。

他手里拿着一瓶水，应该刚从厨房回来。

两人对上视线。

宋尔尔停下：“陆老师，偷听？”

陆执：“路过。”

宋尔尔：“这节目里的路过频率挺高。”

陆执把水瓶拧开，语气淡淡：“主要是别墅太小。”

宋尔尔看了眼楼下。

顾南舟还站在原地，像一尊被欠款砸中的雕像。

她收回视线。

“你刚才都听见了？”

陆执：“听见一点。”

宋尔尔：“哪一点？”

陆执：“没有加班费。”

宋尔尔点头：“重点抓得不错。”

陆执看她：“你很在意钱？”

宋尔尔：“不明显吗？”

陆执：“挺明显。”

宋尔尔：“那就好。我这个人没什么优点，主打一个真实贫穷。”

陆执安静两秒，忽然问：“他真欠你钱？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Nanzhou glanced at the staff next to him and lowered his voice: "Can we talk alone?"

Song Er'er: "No."

Gu Nanzhou was stunned.

He probably didn't expect her to refuse so quickly.

"Why?"

Song Er'er pointed to the overhead camera: "Continuous recording in public areas."

Gu Nanzhou: "Then go to a place where there are no cameras."

Song Er'er: "Not even possible."

Gu Nanzhou frowned: "You must be so guarded against me now?"

Song Er'er: "It's not to guard against you, but to guard against public opinion."

Her tone was quite calm.

"When you come to me, if you can photograph it, it's called old love, but if you can't, it's called a secret meeting."

"You said you just wanted to chat, but netizens said I was backing you again. In the end, you got the impression of being affectionate and I got scolded."

"Gu Nanzhou, I'm familiar with this process."

Gu Nanzhou's expression changed slightly.

Lin Zhi happened to be walking by from the other side of the living room. Hearing this sentence, he paused.

Jiang Mian didn't dare to move.

Zhou Wenye stood at the top of the stairs, folding his arms and watching the excitement.

Gu Nanzhou was silent for a few seconds and then lowered his voice: "You were not like this before."

Song Er'er nodded: "Yes, I used to be stupid."

Gu Nanzhou: "That's not what I meant."

Song Er'er: "It doesn't matter, that's what I mean."

Gu Nanzhou was choked.

Song Er'er glanced at the time: "I'll go up first if I have nothing else to do. I have to rest."

Gu Nanzhou asked subconsciously: "You don't want to talk to me that much?"

Song Er'er: "No."

Gu Nanzhou's eyes were just a little loose.

Song Er'er continued: "The main reason is that there is no overtime pay."

Zhou Wenye turned around directly, his shoulders shaking.

Jiang Mian lowered his head and bit his lip.

Lin Zhi's expression didn't tense up either.

Gu Nanzhou's face darkened greatly.

Song Er'er ignored him and dragged his slippers upstairs.

As soon as he reached the corner of the stairs, he saw Lu Zhi standing there.

He had a bottle of water in his hand and must have just come back from the kitchen.

The two met their eyes.

Song Er'er stopped: "Teacher Lu, are you eavesdropping?"

Lu Zhi: "Passing by."

Song Er'er: "The frequency of passing by in this program is quite high."

Lu Zhi unscrewed the water bottle and said calmly: "The main reason is that the villa is too small."

Song Er'er glanced downstairs.

Gu Nanzhou still stood there, like a statue hit by a debt.

She looked away.

"Did you hear everything just now?"

Lu Zhi: "Listen a little."

Song Er'er: "Which point?"

Lu Zhi: “There is no overtime pay.”

Song Er'er nodded: "The key points are well grasped."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "You care about money?"

Song Er'er: "Isn't it obvious?"

Lu Zhi: "It's quite obvious."

Song Er'er: "That's good. I don't have any merits. I focus on real poverty."

Lu Zhi was quiet for two seconds and suddenly asked, "Does he really owe you money?"
